column1: # Game profile of Kirby Star Allies (Switch, update 4.0.0a = v393216). Plays on the Mac
# HAL Laboratory's own engine on NintendoWare (G3d, Font, Ui2d, Vfx) with nn::atk sound, SDK 4.4.1, NVN; subsdk0 is the movie module (H.264 / AAC MP4 movies, decoded by the host).
# The shaders are BNSH archives inside HAL's .cmp containers under gfx/, ptcl/ and lyt/, in the loose shader/ files and embedded in main (shader_split.py); no run met a shader missing from the map.
# The game asks for present interval 1 and paces its stages at 30 fps itself

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = NintendoSDK_movie 4.4.1)
# The NPDM declares no system resource, so there is no virtual address memory: the game sets a heap of the pool less 64 MB of used memory (3.14 GB, measured), which fits the
# 3.25 GB heap region of this 4 GB block (256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + heap region). The application pool is the Switch's 3285 MB
# ---- Shader split (shader_split.py; BNSH in HAL's .cmp containers, the loose shader/ files and main) ----
